name: Animals and Husbandry
description: Animal Husbandry makes farm animals feel alive.

pages.title: Animals and Husbandry
pages.text:
[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **Key points**

- [#](FFFFFF)[#]() Animals have hunger, cleanliness, happiness, health and traits. Care changes what you get.
- Check them in the **Farm Ledger**.
- Brush them for happiness; sick ones need Animal Medicine.
- Genes pass on traits, like Heavyweight's double meat.
**Animal Husbandry** makes farm animals feel alive. Each has hunger, cleanliness, happiness, health and inherited traits. Care changes what you get.

pages.title: Farm Ledger
pages.text: Tracks hunger, cleanliness, growth, yield, fertility and happiness. The [Farm Magnifying Glass](item://animalhusbandry:magnifying_glass) inspects one animal: sickness, cooldowns, wool and milk.

pages.title: Grooming
pages.text: Brush animals to raise **happiness**. Feeding Troughs hold feed, Brushing Posts help with grooming, and sick animals need [Animal Medicine](item://animalhusbandry:animal_medicine). A Fertility Potion readies a pair to mate.

Traits come from genes:

- A **Glutton** grows fast.
- A **Truffle Snout** finds more truffles.
- A **Heavyweight** drops double meat and leather.

Look at an animal in the ledger to see what it has.

pages.title: Eggs and Cheese
pages.text: Chicken Nests hold eggs. Milk in a cauldron becomes cheese blocks and slices. Pigs with the right trait dig up truffles. Either truffle (this one or Fungi Delight's) works in Animal Medicine and in Fungi Delight dishes.

Create tie-ins: Roosts and Fishing Nets from [#](2E5AAC)[Integrated Farming](entry://food/integrated_farming)[#]() handle poultry on contraptions, and [#](2E5AAC)[Ratatouille](entry://food/ratatouille)[#]()'s Spreader breeds animals.\
\
Bees: [#](2E5AAC)[Productive Bees](entry://food/bees)[#]().

[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **In depth.** The pack runs Animal Husbandry 0.4.2, so there are no rabbit genetics or Angora armor.\
\
Wild animals never get hungry or sick. Care needs start once an animal is domesticated.\
\
Breeding is not instant: the mother carries the young for 3 days (cow), 2 days (sheep, goat) or 1.5 days (pig) before it is born.

pages.title: Taming and breeding
pages.text:
Cows, pigs, sheep, goats and chickens don't breed from wheat or carrots. The first food you hand a wild one tames it. After that, food only fills it, once a day.\
\
Tamed pairs breed by themselves when both are healthy, happy (80 or more) and male and female, within 8 blocks.

Happiness starts at 30. A day with sky or light 8+ adds 5, a brushing adds 10 (once a day), grooming in the last 3 days adds 3. Fed and brushed daily, a pair is ready in about three days.\
\
For a pair right now, use a [Fertility Potion](item://animalhusbandry:fertility_potion) on each. A Farm Magnifying Glass shows if it's male or female.

pages.title: Sickness
pages.text:
Each day a tamed animal may fall sick if it is unhappy (under 50), unfed for more than 3 days, crowded (over 5 animals within 4 blocks) or kept dark (no sky and light under 4). A torch-lit barn is fine.\
\
After 4 sick days it loses a heart a day and can die. Animal Medicine cures it.

pages.title: Troughs and eggs
pages.text:
A Feeding Trough holds feed or water, not both; tamed animals walk to it when hungry.\
\
Only hens lay, and Broody hens never do. An egg laid on stone or planks breaks 4 times in 5; on dirt, sand, hay, wool or leaves 1 in 10. A Chicken Nest keeps them all.
Milk: wild cows milk as usual. A tamed cow gives milk only if she is female and not sick, a few buckets a day.

pages.title: Finding sheep
pages.text: Sheep live in **plains, meadows, cherry groves, forests** (birch, dark, flower), **taiga, groves, windswept hills** and jungles.

Terralith lands with sheep: highlands, shrublands, steppe, valleys, spires and snowy taiga.\
\
**No sheep** in savanna, swamp, desert, badlands, snowy plains, beaches, mushroom fields or oceans.\
\
Animals mostly appear when land is first generated, so look in land you haven't visited yet.

pages.title: Wool without sheep
pages.text:
- **4 string** craft 1 white wool. Spiders drop string; cobwebs give it to a sword or shears.
- **Shepherd villagers** sell wool for an emerald from Apprentice on.
- Four Alex's Caves **Dark Tatters** make black wool.
- **Bulk Washing** (an Encased Fan through water) turns dyed wool white.

[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **In depth.** Naturalist's small animals (snails, rats, moles, hedgehogs, snakes, birds) and other mods' critters share the spawn pool with farm animals. Sheep have extra spawns of their own, so every biome that has sheep has them often.

Other animal mods:

- **Critters and Companions** adds small creatures like red pandas, ferrets, koi, snails and dragonflies. Every snail and dragonfly can be tamed: see [#](2E5AAC)[Creatures](entry://exploration/creatures)[#](). Its otter, Dumbo Octopus and Sea Bunny spawns are off.

- **Naturalist** adds bears, deer, elephants, lions and more. Nine of its sea animals are off; see [#](2E5AAC)[Sea Life](entry://ocean/sea_life)[#]().
- **Sniffers Sniff Delights** gives sniffers a job: see [#](2E5AAC)[Delight Add-ons](entry://food/farmers_delight_addons)[#]().
